intent: Research sealed counterfactual lead MS-0120 as an Evidence-first product-line decomposition of the 2023-2025 memory recovery. Test the alternative to a single 'AI caused the 2024 recovery' narrative by preserving conventional DRAM/NAND supply cuts and inventory normalization separately from HBM and enterprise-SSD AI-driven mix strength. Reuse already-grounded supplier-cut/recovery and HBM/enterprise-storage trajectories, and add only the missing contemporaneous 2024 bridge evidence needed to distinguish broad conventional recovery from AI-specific mix. Do not infer an AI causal share, industry-wide HBM substitution coefficient, or enterprise-SSD AI-only demand quantity unless directly measured by claim-scoped sources.
rationale_summary: Existing executed trajectories already prove supplier production cuts, a later conventional PC/mobile memory-demand improvement milestone, and separate 2024 HBM3E production/supply states. Existing enterprise-SSD research also keeps AI-specific demand magnitude unresolved. MS-0120 therefore needs a bounded bridge, not another broad search: recover contemporaneous 2024 source statements that separate conventional DRAM/NAND recovery or inventory normalization from HBM/AI and enterprise-SSD mix strength.
